items.title: US Stock Futures Rally After AI Rout, Havens Fall: Markets Wrap
items.summary: US equity-index futures rallied as buyers returned following Friday’s selloff in artificial intelligence companies. Treasury futures fell and the yen weakened as demand for haven assets ebbed.

items.title: Indian Stocks Briefly Erase 2026 Losses on Record Foreign Buying
items.summary: Indian shares advanced on Monday in early trade, briefly wiping out their losses for the year before turning lower, as returning foreign money and the unraveling of the AI trade revived demand for overlooked markets.

items.title: Asian Stocks Drop as AI Worries Offset State Support Measures
items.summary: South Korean and Chinese shares fell, showing investor sentiment toward the AI trade remains fragile even after Asian authorities rolled out support measures and US markets showed signs of stabilizing.

items.title: Gold Rebounds as Dip-Buyers Step In After Worst Week Since March
items.summary: Gold rebounded from its biggest weekly decline in eight months, with dip-buyers stepping in as the market pared bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 23
items.summary: Oil fluctuated as traders weighed signs of robust crude exports against the prospect of escalating hostilities in the Middle East.

items.title: South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters
items.summary: South Korea reiterated its commitment to stabilize equity markets, but the measures failed to soothe investor sentiment, with the benchmark Kospi slumping another 5% on Monday following last week’s selloff.

items.title: South Africa’s Woolworths, Momentum Face Investor Pay Challenges
items.summary: Three of South Africa’s best-known companies will face challenges on issues including their pay policies and the independence of some of their directors at annual general meetings over the next week.

items.title: China’s Record State Fund Rescue Masks Deepening Investor Gloom
items.summary: China’s state-backed funds poured a record amount of money into the market on Friday in another forceful attempt to stem a deepening selloff.

items.title: European Gas Surges as Cold Snap Threatens Tight Inventories
items.summary: European natural gas prices jumped after temperature forecasts shifted sharply lower, which could put further pressure on inventories already depleted by export disruptions stemming from the US-Iran war.

items.title: India’s Appeal Grows as Global Tech Selloff Deepens
items.summary: India’s appeal as an anti-AI market is growing as the global tech selloff deepens. From stocks to the currency, Indian assets are drawing fresh foreign interest as several tailwinds fall into place. Bloomberg’s Abhishek Vishnoi explains what to watch this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
